title: Zoox clears final federal hurdle to launch paid robotaxi service
summary: Federal safety regulators have given Zoox a temporary exemption that will allow the Amazon-owned autonomous vehicle technology company to charge customers for rides in its custom-built robotaxi. Zoox custom-built vehicles lack many of the traditional controls required under federal law.
